description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite.
Memnite dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Memnite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1 and put Memnite on the bottom of your library.
The Temporal Anchor triggers, exiling Memnite from the bottom of your library.
Cast Memnite from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.
